head:
<style>
/* Primenjuje se samo na desktop (992px i veće) */
@media (min-width: 992px) {
  .w-dyn-item:nth-child(odd) .grid-featured-work {
    grid-template-columns: 1.55fr 1fr;
  }
  .w-dyn-item:nth-child(odd) .grid-featured-work .text-holder-featured {
    order: 2;
  }
  .w-dyn-item:nth-child(odd) .grid-featured-work .images-work-featured-holder {
    order: 1;
  }
}
</style>

<!-- Nues: Our Work page code. Layout and default states are native classes (visible in the Designer); this block only adds runtime states. -->
<style>
/* Hero slider: the Designer shows the first CMS item; once JS runs, only the active item shows */
.ow-slider.is-ready .ow-hs_item:not(.is-active){opacity:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
.ow-slider.is-ready .ow-hm_item:not(.is-active),.ow-slider.is-ready .ow-hh_item:not(.is-active){display:none}
.ow-slider.is-ready .ow-hs_bar:first-child{background-color:rgba(13,25,40,.2)}
.ow-hs_bar:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:6px}
/* Slider video (CMS Slider video) fades in over the Cover image once it plays */
.ow-hs_video{transition:opacity .5s ease;pointer-events:none}
.ow-hs_video.is-on{opacity:1}
.ow-browser_caret{animation:owBlink 1.1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes owBlink{50%{opacity:0}}
.ow-live-dot:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(91,211,169,.35);animation:owPulse 2s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes owPulse{0%{transform:scale(.4);opacity:.9}100%{transform:scale(1.5);opacity:0}}
/* Arrow buttons: same hover as Home (circle fills mint, arrow turns white) */
.ow-arrow-circle svg circle{transition:fill .3s,stroke .3s,stroke-opacity .3s}
.ow-arrow-circle svg path{transition:stroke .3s}
.ow-hm_view:focus-visible .ow-arrow-circle svg circle,.ow-link-arrow:focus-visible .ow-arrow-circle svg circle{fill:#5bd3a9;stroke:#5bd3a9;stroke-opacity:1}
.ow-hm_view:focus-visible .ow-arrow-circle svg path,.ow-link-arrow:focus-visible .ow-arrow-circle svg path{stroke:#fff}
@media (hover:hover){.ow-hm_view:hover .ow-arrow-circle svg circle,.ow-link-arrow:hover .ow-arrow-circle svg circle{fill:#5bd3a9;stroke:#5bd3a9;stroke-opacity:1}.ow-hm_view:hover .ow-arrow-circle svg path,.ow-link-arrow:hover .ow-arrow-circle svg path{stroke:#fff}}
.ow-cs_go:hover{transform:none}
.ow-cs_go svg circle{transition:fill .3s,stroke .3s,stroke-opacity .3s}
.ow-cs_go svg path{transition:stroke .3s}
/* Case card: the whole card is the link to the case study, so hovering anywhere on it fills the arrow circle */
.ow-cs_side:focus-visible .ow-cs_go svg circle{fill:#5bd3a9;stroke:#5bd3a9;stroke-opacity:1}
.ow-cs_side:focus-visible .ow-cs_go svg path{stroke:#fff}
@media (hover:hover){.ow-cs_side:hover .ow-cs_go svg circle{fill:#5bd3a9;stroke:#5bd3a9;stroke-opacity:1}.ow-cs_side:hover .ow-cs_go svg path{stroke:#fff}}
/* Case tabs: active tab swaps to the light logo */
.ow-case.is-ready .ow-cs_item:not(.is-active){display:none}
.ow-case.is-ready .ow-cs_item.is-active{animation:owFade .5s ease both}
@keyframes owFade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.ow-cs_tab:hover .ow-cs_tab-logo{opacity:.75}
.ow-cs_tab.is-active .ow-cs_tab-logo{display:none}
.ow-cs_tab.is-active .ow-cs_tab-logo.is-light{display:block;opacity:1}
.ow-cs_tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:2px}
.ow-cs_compare img{pointer-events:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.ow-cs_compare.no-before{cursor:default}
.ow-cs_compare.no-before .ow-cs_before,.ow-cs_compare.no-before .ow-cs_handle{display:none}
.ow-cs_range{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:1px;height:1px;margin:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.ow-cs_compare.is-focus .ow-cs_knob{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:3px;border-radius:50%}
.ow-cs_knob svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 14px rgba(13,25,40,.18))}
/* Case heading: faint text, then full navy writes over it letter by letter (same effect as Home and About) */
.ow-cs_char{color:rgba(13,25,40,.4);transition:color .3s ease}
.is-revealed .ow-cs_char{color:inherit}
/* Work grid: Finsweet filter + pagination (fs-list) */
.ow-filter:has(.ow-filter_input:focus-visible),.ow-pager_btn:focus-visible,.ow-pager_arrow:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:3px}
.ow-pager_btn.w--current{background-color:#fff;color:#0d1928}
.ow-pager:not(:has(.w-pagination-previous)):not(:has(.w-pagination-next)){display:none}
.ow-numbers_ring-m{-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(closest-side,#000 84%,transparent 100%);mask-image:radial-gradient(closest-side,#000 84%,transparent 100%)}
@media (min-width:992px) and (max-width:1279px){.ow-cs_side{width:340px}.ow-cs_big{font-size:42px}.ow-stat_value{font-size:32px}.ow-stat_label{font-size:17px}.ow-hs_metric{left:auto;top:auto;right:-20px;bottom:7%}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ow-hs_video{display:none}.ow-browser_caret,.ow-live-dot:after{animation:none}.ow-hs_item{transition:none}.ow-case.is-ready .ow-cs_item.is-active{animation:none}.ow-cs_char{transition:none}}
</style>
<style>
/* Numbers: scroll-driven results rings (same animation as the service pages), drawn from the native .ow-stat blocks */
[data-ow-rings]{--nr-c1:#FFFFFF;--nr-c2:#FFFFFF;--nr-soft:#E9EEF2;--nr-glow:rgba(255,255,255,.24);--nr-ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);overflow:visible}
/* The heading scrolls in like any section; then the rings stage pins to the screen (sticky) while the empty scroll room
   under it (.ow-numbers_inner::after) drives the animation. The heading is not pinned, so the rings get the whole screen
   and reach the Figma size (600px rings in a 1000px graphic at 1440). */
[data-ow-rings] .ow-numbers_inner{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;grid-row-gap:2.5rem}
[data-ow-rings] .ow-numbers_inner::after{content:"";display:block;flex:none;width:1px;height:320vh}
[data-ow-rings] .ow-numbers_viz{position:sticky;top:0;width:100%;height:100vh;height:100svh;max-width:none;aspect-ratio:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding-top:5.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;box-sizing:border-box}
[data-ow-rings].nr-on .ow-numbers_ring,[data-ow-rings].nr-on .ow-numbers_ring-m,[data-ow-rings].nr-on .ow-numbers_viz>.ow-stat{display:none}
.nr-box{position:relative;width:min(980px,100%,calc((100vh - 7rem) * 1000 / 680));width:min(980px,100%,calc((100svh - 7rem) * 1000 / 680));aspect-ratio:1000/680;container-type:inline-size}
/* The drawing is cropped to the rings and labels (viewBox 60 60 1000 680). Glow sits right behind the logo: the ring centre (400,400)
   is 34% / 50% of .nr-box; it is sized from the box so it stays centred and in proportion at every screen size. */
.nr-box::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:34%;top:50%;width:126%;height:185.3%;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(calc(.6 + var(--p,0) * .5));opacity:calc(.25 + var(--p,0) * .75);background:radial-gradient(50% 50% at 50% 50%,var(--nr-glow) 0%,transparent 70%)}
.nr-box svg{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.nr-track{fill:none;stroke:var(--nr-soft);stroke-opacity:.08;transform-origin:400px 400px;transform:scale(.6) rotate(-40deg);opacity:0;transition:transform 1.3s var(--nr-ease),opacity .8s ease}
.nr-arc{fill:none;stroke-linecap:round}
.nr-lead{fill:none;stroke:var(--nr-soft);stroke-opacity:.5;stroke-width:1}
.nr-orbit{fill:none;stroke:var(--nr-soft);stroke-opacity:.2;stroke-dasharray:2 10;transform-origin:400px 400px;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease .6s;animation:nr-spin 80s linear infinite}
@keyframes nr-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.nr-mark .ol{fill:none;stroke:var(--nr-c2);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
/* Once the outline is fully drawn, drop the dash so the start corner joins cleanly (no notch where the draw begins and ends) */
.nr-mark.full .ol{stroke-dasharray:none}
.nr-mark .fl{opacity:.1;transition:opacity .9s ease}
.nr-mark.full .fl{opacity:1}
.nr-half{transition:transform 1.1s var(--nr-ease),opacity .6s ease}
.nr-h1{transform:translate(-60px,40px);opacity:0}
.nr-h2{transform:translate(60px,-40px);opacity:0}
.nr-pulse{fill:none;stroke:var(--nr-c1);stroke-width:1.5;opacity:0;transform-origin:400px 400px}
.nr-mark.full~.nr-pulse{animation:nr-pulse 2.8s var(--nr-ease) infinite}
@keyframes nr-pulse{0%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(.55)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.15)}}
.nr-glint{fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;opacity:0}
.nr-box.ready .nr-track{transform:none;opacity:1}
.nr-box.ready .nr-orbit{opacity:1}
.nr-box.ready .nr-h1,.nr-box.ready .nr-h2{transform:none;opacity:1;transition-delay:.35s}
.nr-box.ready .nr-glint{animation:nr-glint 1.2s var(--nr-ease) 1.25s forwards}
@keyframes nr-glint{0%{opacity:0;stroke-dashoffset:1}30%{opacity:.9}100%{opacity:0;stroke-dashoffset:-1}}
.nr-lab{position:absolute;left:77.6%;transform:translate(14px,-50%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .7s var(--nr-ease);display:flex;flex-direction:column;grid-row-gap:.5em;white-space:nowrap}
.nr-lab.in{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,-50%)}
.nr-lab .ow-stat_value{font-size:clamp(22px,3.3cqw,32px);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.nr-lab .ow-stat_label{font-size:clamp(13px,2cqw,20px)}
.nr-list{display:none}
@media (max-width:767px){
.nr-box::before{left:50%;width:200%;height:200%}
[data-ow-rings] .ow-numbers_inner{grid-row-gap:1.5rem}
[data-ow-rings] .ow-numbers_viz{grid-row-gap:1.5rem;padding-top:5rem}
.nr-box{width:min(100%,calc(100vh - 360px),420px);width:min(100%,calc(100svh - 360px),420px);aspect-ratio:1/1}
.nr-lab,.nr-lead,.nr-end{display:none}
.nr-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.25rem 1rem;width:100%;max-width:420px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.nr-list li{opacity:.25;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .7s var(--nr-ease)}
.nr-list li.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.nr-list .ow-stat_value{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:28px}
.nr-list .ow-stat_value i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
.nr-list .ow-stat_label{margin-top:6px;padding-left:16px;font-size:13px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[data-ow-rings] .ow-numbers_inner::after{display:none}[data-ow-rings] .ow-numbers_viz{position:relative;height:auto;padding-top:0}.nr-orbit{animation:none}}
[data-ow-rings] .nr-track{stroke:#0d1928;stroke-opacity:1}
[data-ow-rings] .nr-lead{stroke-opacity:.65}
[data-ow-rings] .nr-orbit{display:none}
[data-ow-rings] .nr-lab .ow-stat_value,[data-ow-rings] .nr-list .ow-stat_value{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ow-numbers[data-ow-rings]{overflow:visible}
/* Figma 6386:3795: the rings are white and greys (outer to inner #fff, #adb1b6, #d8d9dc, #a0a5ab) on a soft grey light that fades out past the outer ring */
[data-ow-rings] .nr-box::before{background:radial-gradient(50% 50% at 50% 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.24) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.135) 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.105) 43%,rgba(255,255,255,.067) 48.5%,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 57%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 68%)}
</style>
<style>
/* Work card thumbnail (nues-work-grid): Card background + the site (Hero screen center) as a window rising from the bottom edge.
   Hover opens the window to the full preview and scrolls the homepage. No screenshot = 'Launching soon'. No Card background = old Main Image card. */
.work-card_media{container-type:inline-size}
.work-card_window{border-radius:1.95cqw 1.95cqw 0 0;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(16,25,39,.06),0 2.4cqw 6cqw -2cqw rgba(16,25,39,.28);transition:left .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),right .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),top .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),bottom .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-radius .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.work-card_shot{transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
@media (hover:hover){.work-card_component:hover .work-card_window{left:0;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:0}
/* the site scrolls at an even pace whatever its length (--shot-y / --shot-dur from the script: about 500px a second, 3 to 12s); a short screenshot stays put; leaving glides back up */
.work-card_component:hover .work-card_shot{transform:translateY(var(--shot-y,min(0px,calc(-100% + 62.5cqw))));transition:transform var(--shot-dur,4s) cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) .35s}}
.work-card_bg.w-dyn-bind-empty,.work-card_window:has(.work-card_shot.w-dyn-bind-empty),.work-card_media:has(.work-card_shot:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) .work-card_soon,
.work-card_media:has(.work-card_bg.w-dyn-bind-empty) :is(.work-card_window,.work-card_soon),.work-card_media:has(.work-card_bg:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) .work-card_img{display:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.work-card_window,.work-card_shot{transition:none}.work-card_component:hover .work-card_shot{transform:none}}
</style>

<!-- Before/after card (Figma 8420:1075 + nues-before-after-slider.html): runtime states; layout is native classes -->
<style>
.ow-cs_bg.w-dyn-bind-empty{display:none}
.ow-cs_url:has(.ow-cs_host.w-dyn-bind-empty){visibility:hidden}
.ow-cs_knob svg{filter:none}
.ow-cs_chev{flex:none;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
@media (hover:hover){.ow-cs_compare:hover .ow-cs_knob{width:52px;margin-left:-26px}.ow-cs_compare:hover .ow-cs_chev.is-l{transform:translateX(-2px)}.ow-cs_compare:hover .ow-cs_chev.is-r{transform:translateX(2px)}}
.ow-cs_compare.is-drag .ow-cs_knob{width:40px;height:56px;margin:-28px 0 0 -20px}
.ow-cs_compare.is-focus .ow-cs_knob{border-radius:22px}
.ow-cs_label.is-hidden{opacity:0}
.ow-cs_compare.no-before .ow-cs_labels{display:none}
@media (max-width:767px){.ow-cs_compare.is-drag .ow-cs_knob{width:34px;height:48px;margin:-24px 0 0 -17px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ow-cs_knob,.ow-cs_chev,.ow-cs_label{transition:none}}
</style>
<!-- Nues: Our Work page code. Every slide, bar, tab and card is a CMS Collection List item; this script only switches the active one. -->
<script>
(function () {
  var reduce = !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
  function arr(list) { return Array.prototype.slice.call(list || []); }
  function noImg(img) { return !img || img.classList.contains('w-dyn-bind-empty') || !(img.getAttribute('src') || '').trim(); }
  function onKeys(el, fn) {
    el.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); fn(); }
    });
  }

  /* Work filters: one radio group for Finsweet List Filter, then load Finsweet (fs-list + fs-numbercount) */
  function prepFilters() {
    var form = document.querySelector('.ow-filters');
    if (!form) return;
    arr(form.querySelectorAll('.ow-filter_input')).forEach(function (inp) {
      var wrap = inp.closest('.ow-filter');
      var label = wrap && wrap.querySelector('.ow-filter_label');
      var all = inp.id === 'ow-filter-all';
      var v = all ? '' : (inp.getAttribute('fs-list-value') || inp.value || (label ? label.textContent.trim() : ''));
      inp.name = 'category';
      inp.value = v;
      inp.setAttribute('fs-list-field', 'category');
      inp.setAttribute('fs-list-value', v);
      inp.setAttribute('fs-list-activeclass', 'is-active');
      inp.setAttribute('fs-list-operator', 'equal');
      if (all) inp.checked = true;
      else if (wrap) wrap.setAttribute('fs-list-emptyfacet', 'hide');
    });
  }
  function loadFinsweet() {
    if (document.querySelector('script[src*="@finsweet/attributes"]')) return;
    var s = document.createElement('script');
    s.type = 'module';
    s.async = true;
    s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@finsweet/attributes@2/attributes.js';
    s.setAttribute('fs-list', '');
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }
  try { prepFilters(); } catch (e) { if (window.console) console.warn('ow filters', e); }
  loadFinsweet();

  /* Hero: slides, bars, domain and meta are four CMS lists with the same filter, so they line up by index.
     A slide with a Slider video (CMS link field with a direct MP4/WebM URL, bound to the data-video-src attribute of the hidden
     .ow-hs_video-src link in the slide) plays it muted over
     its Cover image: that slide lasts as long as the video and its bar follows the video. Without a video, or if the video
     cannot play (blocked, failed, too slow to start), the slide shows the Cover image for 6 seconds as before. */
  function initHero() {
    var slider = document.querySelector('.ow-slider');
    if (!slider) return;
    var slides = arr(slider.querySelectorAll('.ow-hs_item'));
    var n = slides.length;
    if (!n) { slider.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    var metas = arr(slider.querySelectorAll('.ow-hm_item'));
    var hosts = arr(slider.querySelectorAll('.ow-hh_item'));
    var bars = arr(slider.querySelectorAll('.ow-hs_bar'));
    function fill(i, v) { if (bars[i]) bars[i].style.setProperty('--ow-progress', v); }
    var prog = slider.querySelector('.ow-hs_progress');
    if (n < 2 && prog) prog.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    var idx = 0, DUR = 6000, WAIT = 4000, elapsed = 0, wait = 0, last = null, kbFocus = false, inView = true;
    var vids = slides.map(function (s) {
      var a = s.querySelector('.ow-hs_video-src');
      var src = a ? (a.getAttribute('data-video-src') || '').trim() : '';
      if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(src)) src = '';
      if (reduce || !src) return null;
      var box = s.querySelector('.ow-hs_slide') || s;
      var img = box.querySelector('.ow-hs_img');
      var v = document.createElement('video');
      v.className = 'ow-hs_video';
      v.muted = true; v.defaultMuted = true; v.playsInline = true; v.loop = n < 2; v.preload = 'none';
      v.setAttribute('muted', ''); v.setAttribute('playsinline', ''); v.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      v.setAttribute('data-src', src);
      if (img && !noImg(img)) v.poster = img.currentSrc || img.src;
      box.insertBefore(v, img ? img.nextSibling : box.firstChild);
      var st = { el: v, bad: false, pending: false };
      v.addEventListener('playing', function () { if (!st.bad) v.classList.add('is-on'); });
      v.addEventListener('error', function () { drop(st); });
      return st;
    });
    function drop(st) { st.bad = true; st.el.classList.remove('is-on'); try { st.el.pause(); } catch (e) {} }
    function load(i) {
      var st = vids[i];
      if (st && !st.bad && !st.el.getAttribute('src')) { st.el.preload = 'auto'; st.el.src = st.el.getAttribute('data-src'); }
    }
    function render() {
      slides.forEach(function (s, i) {
        s.classList.toggle('is-active', i === idx);
        s.setAttribute('aria-hidden', i === idx ? 'false' : 'true');
        var st = vids[i];
        if (st && i !== idx && !st.el.paused) st.el.pause();
      });
      [metas, hosts].forEach(function (list) {
        list.forEach(function (m, i) { m.classList.toggle('is-active', i === idx); });
      });
      bars.forEach(function (b, i) {
        fill(i, i < idx || (i === idx && reduce) ? '100%' : '0%');
        b.setAttribute('aria-current', i === idx ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      var cur = vids[idx];
      if (cur && !cur.bad && cur.el.readyState > 0) { try { cur.el.currentTime = 0; } catch (e) {} }
      load(idx);
      if (n > 1) load((idx + 1) % n);
    }
    function go(i) { idx = (i + n) % n; elapsed = 0; wait = 0; last = null; render(); }
    bars.forEach(function (b, i) {
      b.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      b.tabIndex = 0;
      b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show project: ' + (b.getAttribute('aria-label') || i + 1));
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i); });
      onKeys(b, function () { go(i); });
    });
    function tick(t) {
      var run = !reduce && !kbFocus && inView && !document.hidden;
      var dt = last === null ? 0 : Math.min(t - last, 100);
      last = run ? t : null;
      var st = vids[idx];
      if (st && !st.bad) {
        var v = st.el;
        if (run) {
          if (v.paused && !v.ended && !st.pending) {
            st.pending = true;
            var pr = v.play();
            if (pr && pr.then) pr.then(function () { st.pending = false; }, function () { st.pending = false; drop(st); });
            else st.pending = false;
          }
        } else if (!v.paused) {
          v.pause();
        }
        if (v.duration && v.readyState > 1) {
          fill(idx, (Math.min(v.currentTime / v.duration, 1) * 100) + '%');
          if (!v.loop && (v.ended || v.currentTime >= v.duration - 0.05)) go(idx + 1);
        } else if (run && (wait += dt) > WAIT) {
          drop(st);
        }
      } else if (run) {
        elapsed += dt;
        var p = Math.min(elapsed / DUR, 1);
        fill(idx, (p * 100) + '%');
        if (p >= 1) go(idx + 1);
      }
      window.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    /* Keeps running on hover and after a click; only keyboard focus pauses it, so keyboard users can stop the motion */
    slider.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
      try { kbFocus = e.target.matches(':focus-visible'); } catch (err) { kbFocus = false; }
    });
    slider.addEventListener('focusout', function () { kbFocus = false; });
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      new IntersectionObserver(function (es) { inView = es[0].isIntersecting; }).observe(slider);
    }
    slider.classList.add('is-ready');
    render();
    if (n > 1 || vids[0]) window.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
